title: 第三章 聒噪第四章 灵元
lines: 第三章聒噪跨过徐家大门，迎着阳光，柳无邪深吸一口气。
他堂堂仙帝，还不至于跟一群下人一般见识。
沧澜城很大，居住几百万人口，除了四大家族，势力最大当属沧澜城主。
城中街道纵横交错，商铺林立，大燕皇朝极大，沧澜城不过其中一城罢了。
柳无邪要去的地方叫丹宝阁，沧澜城最大的药材供应商，丹药售卖点，不属于任何一个家族，更不受城主管辖，超然世外，听说他们背后站着是势力极其庞大的天宝宗。
续脉丹很罕见，品阶不高，炼制起来难度极大。
金光闪闪三个大字，挂在丹宝阁门楣上，远远就能看的一清二楚，进出武者很多。
顺着人流，柳无邪走进去，映入眼帘是一座巨大的殿宇，分为好几个区域，丹药贩卖点，药材贩卖区域等等。
还有一些妖兽皮毛以及内丹，隔着柜台，掩盖不掉丹药散发出的香味，妖兽内丹释放出的凶煞之气。
“请问公子需要点什么？”
一名青衣小厮快步上前，很热情打了一声招呼，眼眸深处却闪过一丝鄙夷，跟其他人相比，柳无邪穿着太普通，身上青衫洗的发白。
“我要见你们管事，麻烦你通报一声。”
对方眼眸中的鄙夷，柳无邪尽收眼底，嘴角浮现一抹冷笑。
“我们管事很忙，没时间见闲人，不买药就滚出去。”
青衣小厮毫不客气，推搡一下，却没推动，一缕杀意从柳无邪眼眸一闪而逝。
这边举动，引来许多人注意，纷纷驻足观望，朝他们看过来。
“他不是徐家赘婿吗，怎么跑到丹宝阁来了。”
关于徐家赘婿，早已传遍整个沧澜城，无人不知，尤其是昨晚的一幕，更是家喻户晓。
听到徐家赘婿，青衣小厮脸上闪过一丝嘲讽，还有一抹冷笑，一副厌恶的样子。
“滚开，我们丹宝阁不做你的生意。”
小厮面露凶光，要让柳无邪赶紧滚，不准踏足丹宝阁，好狂的口气。
丹宝阁不受任何势力管辖，造成这些青衣小厮，眼高于顶，目空一切，进来的武者，通常都是巴结的表情。
丹宝阁一名小小的青衣小厮，也不是普通人能得罪得起，可想而知，丹宝阁的地位如何崇高。
“你确定要错过这桩生意，别怪我没提醒你，这桩生意一旦错过，怕你承受不起。”
柳无邪眼眸一冷，寒意笼罩，吓得青衣小厮一个踉跄。
“该死，你这个废物敢威胁我，你不肯走，那我就打死你丢出去。”
说打就打，丹宝阁的小厮实力都不低，一拳朝柳无邪面门袭来，奇快无比，拳风发出呼啸，产生一股气旋，撩起柳无邪鬓角发丝。
换成常人，青衣小厮还不敢出手，徐家赘婿，早已成过街老鼠，人人喊打，对他出手，毫无压力。
拳风还未靠近，柳无邪抬脚了，一脚狠狠的踢在青衣小厮的腹部，身体高高抛起，砸在柜台上，坚硬的柜台四分五裂，里面的药材，散落满地。
突如其来的一脚，踢得所有人措手不及，人群自动腾出一大块位置，免得惹祸上身，得罪丹宝阁，以后别想在沧澜城混了。
青衣小厮在地面上咳血，从其他几个方向，突然冲过来十几名小厮，其中两人手持兵器，围住柳无邪。
“你太放肆了，敢在我们丹宝阁伤人，拿下他。”
content_en:
Chapter 3 Noisy walked through the gate of Xu's house, facing the sunshine, Liu Wuxie took a deep breath.
He is a dignified Immortal Emperor, but he is not as experienced as a group of servants.
Canglan City is very large, with millions of people living there. Apart from the four major families, the most powerful one is the Lord of Canglan City.
The streets in the city are criss-crossed and there are many shops. The Yan Dynasty was huge, and Canglan City was just one of them.
The place Liu Wuxie was going to was called Danbao Pavilion. It was the largest supplier of medicinal materials in Canglan City and a selling point for elixirs. It did not belong to any family, nor was it under the jurisdiction of the city lord. It was aloof from the world. I heard that the extremely powerful Tianbao Sect was standing behind them.
The Pulse Renewal Pill is very rare, its grade is not high, and it is extremely difficult to refine.
The three big characters "Golden Shine" are hung on the lintel of the Danbao Pavilion. They can be seen clearly from a distance. There are many warriors coming in and out.
Following the flow of people, Liu Wuxie walked in, and what he saw was a huge palace, divided into several areas, elixir selling points, medicinal materials selling areas, etc.
There are also some monster furs and inner elixirs, which can't cover up the fragrance of the elixirs across the counter, and the evil aura released by the monster inner elixirs.
"Excuse me, sir, what do you need?"
A young man in green clothes quickly stepped forward and greeted him warmly, but a hint of contempt flashed deep in his eyes. Compared with the others, Liu Wuxie was dressed too ordinary, and the blue clothes on his body were washed white.
"I want to see you in charge of things, please let me know."
Liu Wuxie could see the contempt in the other party's eyes, and a sneer appeared on the corner of his mouth.
"We are very busy in charge and don't have time to see idle people. If you don't buy medicine, get out."
The young man in green clothes was not polite and pushed him, but did not push him. A trace of killing intent flashed from Liu Wuxie's eyes.
This move attracted the attention of many people, who stopped to watch and looked towards them.
"Isn't he the Xu family's son-in-law? Why did he come to Danbao Pavilion?"
The news about the Xu family's adopted son-in-law has long spread throughout Canglan City, and no one knows about it. Especially the scene last night has become a household name.
When he heard that the Xu family had adopted a son-in-law, a trace of ridicule flashed across the young man's face, as well as a sneer and a look of disgust.
"Go away, we at Danbao Pavilion don't do your business."
The boy had a fierce look on his face and told Liu Wuxie to get out of here quickly and not to set foot in the Danbao Pavilion. He sounded so crazy.
Danbao Pavilion is not under the jurisdiction of any force, which makes these young men in green clothes look higher than their heads and are arrogant. The warriors who come in usually have fawning expressions.
A young man in green clothes in Danbao Pavilion is not someone ordinary people can afford to offend. It is conceivable how high the status of Danbao Pavilion is.
"You are sure you want to miss this business. Don't blame me for not reminding you. If you miss this business, I'm afraid you won't be able to afford it."
Liu Wuxie's eyes turned cold, and a chill enveloped him, making the young man in green stagger in fright.
"Damn it, you loser dares to threaten me and you refuse to leave, then I will beat you to death and throw you out."
He hit as fast as he wanted. The young man from Danbao Pavilion was very powerful. He punched Liu Wuxie in the face with great speed. The wind of the punch roared, creating a whirlpool and lifting the hair from Liu Wuxie's temples.
If it were an ordinary person, the boy in Tsing Yi wouldn't dare to take action. The Xu family's adopted son-in-law has already become a street rat. Everyone shouts to beat him, but there is no pressure to take action against him.
"Bang!"
Before the fist wind came close, Liu Wuxie raised his foot and kicked the young man in Qingyi's abdomen hard. His body was thrown up high and hit the counter. The hard counter fell into pieces and the medicinal materials inside were scattered all over the floor.
The sudden kick caught everyone off guard, and the crowd automatically vacated a large space to avoid getting into trouble, offending Danbao Pavilion, and not wanting to hang out in Canglan City in the future.
"Ahem..."
The boy in green clothes was coughing up blood on the ground. A dozen boys suddenly rushed over from several other directions, two of them holding weapons and surrounding Liu Wuxie.
"You are too presumptuous. You dare to hurt someone in our Danbao Pavilion. Take him down."
